description: Held-out raw-native-model coding benchmark across JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust. Evaluation scripts remain outside the model-visible workspace.

tasks.title: Normalize strings into deterministic ASCII slugs
tasks.goal: Implement slugify(value: str | None) in src/slug.py. Return an empty string for None. Otherwise lowercase the input, replace each consecutive run of characters outside ASCII letters and digits with one hyphen, and trim leading/trailing hyphens. Keep the existing function name and do not add dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement inclusive numeric clamping
tasks.goal: Implement clamp(value: float, minimum: float, maximum: float) in src/math_utils.py. Return minimum below the lower bound, maximum above the upper bound, and the original value inside the inclusive range. Assume minimum <= maximum. Do not mutate inputs.

tasks.title: Merge nested configuration mappings without mutation
tasks.goal: Implement merge_config(base, override) in src/config.py. Recursively merge nested dictionaries, preserve base keys that are absent from override, and replace lists rather than merging their elements. Return a new dictionary and do not mutate either input.

tasks.title: Format elapsed seconds into compact duration units
tasks.goal: Implement format_duration(total_seconds) in src/duration.py. Accept a non-negative finite number of seconds, floor fractional seconds, and format non-zero units as compact tokens separated by one space: hours as h, minutes as m, seconds as s. Omit zero-valued units, except return 0s for zero. Do not add dependencies.

tasks.title: Split a sequence into ordered fixed-size chunks
tasks.goal: Implement chunk_array(values, size) in src/chunks.py. Return consecutive ordered lists, each no larger than size. Preserve item order and values. Return an empty list when values is empty. For a non-positive or non-integer size, return an empty list. Do not mutate the input.

tasks.title: Normalize and reject unsafe relative paths
tasks.goal: Implement normalize_relative_path(value) in src/path_utils.py. Accept only strings. Normalize backslashes to forward slashes, collapse repeated separators, and remove '.' segments. Reject empty/whitespace-only paths, NUL characters, absolute POSIX paths, UNC paths, Windows drive-prefixed paths, and any '..' segment by returning None. Otherwise return the normalized relative path. Preserve Unicode filename characters. Do not use platform-dependent path resolution or add dependencies.

tasks.title: Look up HTTP headers case-insensitively
tasks.goal: Implement lookup_header(headers, name, default=None) in src/headers.py. Match header names using case-insensitive Unicode casefold semantics. Return the value belonging to the first matching key in the input mapping's iteration order. Return default when no matching key exists. Do not mutate the mapping or normalize returned values.

tasks.title: Calculate bounded exponential retry delay
tasks.goal: Implement calculate_backoff(attempt, base_delay, max_delay) in src/backoff.py. Attempts are 1-based. For attempt less than one return 0.0. Otherwise return min(base_delay * 2 ** (attempt - 1), max_delay) for finite non-negative delay inputs. Avoid excessive intermediate values or overflow for very large attempt values by respecting the cap. Do not mutate inputs or add dependencies.

tasks.title: Constrain a multi-key generic object mapper
tasks.goal: Repair the connected TypeScript type definitions and implementation in src/types.ts and src/mapper.ts. Define StringKeyOf<T> as the string keys of T, constrain MappedRecord and mapObject's selected key generic to keys that actually exist on the source object, and type the mapper callback with the source value type rather than unknown. Return an object containing only the requested keys, with the mapped value type, while preserving the source object. Invalid source keys must be rejected by the compiler. Both files must be updated coherently in this one patch response.

tasks.title: Build a cancellation-aware concurrent unique-value collector
tasks.goal: Repair CollectUnique in syncutil/collector.go. Consume the input channel with a bounded worker pool, stop promptly when ctx is cancelled even when the input channel remains open, synchronize shared state with a mutex, deduplicate exact original strings without lowercasing or mutating them, and return unique values sorted lexicographically. A non-positive worker count must return an empty result. Ensure every started worker is accounted for and joined; do not leak blocked goroutines or introduce external dependencies.

tasks.title: Return lifetime-bound safe UTF-8 byte slices
tasks.goal: Repair safe_str_slice in src/lib.rs. It must return Option<&str> whose lifetime is tied to the borrowed input, perform no allocation or copying, and return None for out-of-range, reversed, or non-UTF-8-boundary byte ranges rather than panicking. Use Rust's checked string slicing primitives and preserve valid empty and ASCII slices.

tasks.title: Clamp and validate a JSON stream state across modules
tasks.goal: Implement the cross-module stream-state contract in both src/limits.py and src/state.py. clamp_sample must reject booleans/non-numeric and non-finite values, reject invalid bounds, and clamp finite numeric samples to the inclusive minimum/maximum range. parse_stream_state must return None for malformed JSON, a non-object root, missing/blank state, non-list samples, or invalid numeric bounds; valid state names are trimmed, invalid individual sample values are skipped, and valid samples are clamped through the shared clamp_sample function. Return exactly {'state': trimmed_state, 'samples': clamped_samples} for valid payloads. Both modules must be updated in one structured response so their contract remains aligned.

tasks.title: Normalize and validate events across connected ESM modules
tasks.goal: Implement the event normalization contract across src/schema.mjs and src/normalize-event.mjs. isRecord must accept only non-null, non-array objects. normalizeEventType must require a non-empty string, trim it, and lowercase it. normalizeTimestamp must accept only finite non-negative numbers or valid date strings and return an integer epoch-millisecond value; reject booleans, negative values, non-finite values, and invalid dates. normalizeEvent must accept either a JSON string or an object, return null for malformed JSON, invalid root records, missing/blank type, invalid timestamp, or non-record payload, and return exactly {type, timestamp, payload} for a valid event. Deep-clone the payload so nested objects are not aliased or mutated. Keep shared validation in schema.mjs and make normalize-event.mjs use those shared functions; both modules must be updated in one response.

tasks.title: Map asynchronous inputs with bounded concurrency and stable ordering
tasks.goal: Implement async mapConcurrent(items, mapper, options) in src/map-concurrent.mjs. Require an array and callable mapper; options must be a non-array object; default concurrency to 4 and require an integer from 1 through 64. Snapshot the input at call time, invoke mapper(value, index), run no more than concurrency mappers at once, and resolve to a result array in original input order even when individual operations finish out of order. Treat synchronous throws and rejected mapper promises identically: after the first rejection, start no queued items, wait for every mapper already in flight to settle, then reject with the first failure reason. Empty arrays resolve to an empty array. Do not mutate the caller's input or add dependencies.
